title: hierarchical menu is not returning sub level data

comments.body: Hey! could you make this in a sandbox, I think this might possibly be related to how you are mounting the widget. There's a svelte starter here: https://codesandbox.io/s/svelte-forked-enk4e?file=/App.svelte

However note that the sub-level will only be filled once the item is refined, since we can not fetch _all possible_ facets on every query, only those relevant to this current query, otherwise this would need exponentially more requests

hi @Haroenv,
Thanks for your quick feedback.
After further testing, it happens that some times it works (but most of the time its not) but Im not able to figure out why. 
And yes I noticed that the sub-level should be filled once a first level value is refined.

Also I forget to mention that Im using the onMount svelte hook cause I'm in a SSR environment with Sapper and as instantsearch.js is not supporting SSR, I have to import it only on the frontend side which is done by the onMount. 

I come back to you with a sandbox ;) Thanks again.

I get ride of the JS error I mentioned by delaying the initialisation of Algolia Search. 
But still struggling to get sub-level data 🤔 and I cannot reproduce in the sandbox 😭

Ok finally figured out the problem.
It's because I have on the same view a menu widget (the single level one) using the same attribute (hierarchical_categories_en.lvl0) than the hierarchical menu. 
Is that a bug or is it my UX implementation that shouldn't exist having those 2 widgets in parallel  😅 ?

ah yes unfortunately using both in the same view will cause an error if they have a different value, since they use the same parameter (we have an open issue somewhere to throw an error when an attribute is used more than once, but it used to be hard to throw, I think it might be possible now)

Ok I see. I close the issue.
Thanks for the quick support @Haroenv. 🤙
Excited to see your svelte InstantSearch, don't hesitate to share on https://discourse.algolia.com once you're done!
